title: A lost building fob
context: You will hear two roommates who rent a condo in Burnaby talking about a lost building key fob and how to replace it.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: Farid, have you seen my fob? The blue one. I swear I put it in my jacket pocket last night.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: The building fob? No. Did you check your gym bag? You had it at the pool yesterday, right?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: I checked everywhere. Gym bag, the car, the couch. Honestly, I think it fell out when I was taking my phone out at the bus stop on Kingsway.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Okay, that's not great. Anyone who finds it can get into the parkade and the bike room. Remember that email from strata last spring about bikes going missing?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: Don't remind me. Okay, so I need to report it. Who do we even contact, the building manager?

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: No, the building manager just handles repairs. Fobs go through the property management company, Westgate something. Their number's on the notice board in the lobby.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: And until then, how am I supposed to get in? I've got a shift at seven tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: You can take mine in the morning. I work from home on Wednesdays, so I won't need it.

questions.prompt: Where does Chloe think she lost the fob?

options.text: At the swimming pool.
options.whyVi: Đó là gợi ý của Farid; Chloe đã kiểm tra túi tập và không thấy.

options.text: In the parkade of the building.
options.whyVi: 'Parkade' được nhắc khi nói ai nhặt được fob có thể vào đâu, không phải nơi đánh rơi.

options.text: While she was waiting for a bus.
options.whyVi: Đúng: cô nghĩ nó rơi khi lấy điện thoại ở trạm xe buýt trên đường Kingsway.

options.text: Somewhere inside her car.
options.whyVi: Chloe có tìm trong xe nhưng không thấy; cô không nghĩ mất ở đó.

questions.evidence: I think it fell out when I was taking my phone out at the bus stop on Kingsway.
questions.explanationVi: Chloe nói 'it fell out... at the bus stop on Kingsway'. Đáp án C diễn đạt 'at the bus stop' thành 'while she was waiting for a bus'.

questions.prompt: Why is Farid worried about the lost fob?

options.text: A stranger could use it to enter shared parts of the building.
options.whyVi: Đúng: ai nhặt được có thể vào bãi đỗ xe và phòng để xe đạp.

options.text: Chloe's bike was stolen last spring.
options.whyVi: Email của strata hồi mùa xuân nói chung về xe đạp bị mất trong tòa nhà, không nói xe của Chloe.

options.text: Chloe might be late for her shift.
options.whyVi: Chính Chloe lo về ca làm sáng mai, không phải lý do Farid lo lắng.

options.text: The strata will fine them for losing it.
options.whyVi: Ở đoạn này không ai nói tới tiền phạt vì làm mất fob.

questions.evidence: Anyone who finds it can get into the parkade and the bike room.
questions.explanationVi: 'Anyone who finds it can get into the parkade and the bike room' = người lạ có thể vào khu vực chung. Câu nhắc email về xe đạp chỉ minh họa nỗi lo này.

questions.prompt: Why is Farid able to lend Chloe his fob tomorrow?

options.text: He has a spare fob at home.
options.whyVi: Farid không nói có fob dự phòng.

options.text: His shift starts later than hers.
options.whyVi: Farid không nói về giờ làm; anh làm việc tại nhà.

options.text: The building manager will let him in.
options.whyVi: Building manager được nhắc nhưng chỉ phụ trách sửa chữa.

options.text: He will not be leaving home for work that day.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'I work from home on Wednesdays, so I won't need it'.

questions.evidence: I work from home on Wednesdays, so I won't need it.
questions.explanationVi: Farid làm việc ở nhà vào thứ Tư (ngày mai) nên không cần fob. 'Work from home' = không ra khỏi nhà đi làm.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: Okay, I just got off the phone with Westgate. So, they'll deactivate the old one right away, which is good. But the replacement is a hundred and twenty-five dollars.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: A hundred and twenty-five? For a little piece of plastic?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: That's what I said. And it's not just that. Because we're renters, the owner has to fill out an authorization form. They won't release a fob to a tenant directly.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: So we need Mr. Okafor to sign something. He's in Calgary until the end of the month, isn't he?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: He can sign it electronically, they said. That part's fine. Oh, and pickup is only Tuesdays and Thursdays, between ten and two.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Hmm. You know, my cousin got a copy made at one of those key kiosks in Metrotown. It was like thirty-five bucks.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: I asked about that, actually. The woman said the strata bylaws don't allow copied fobs. If they find one in the system, they can fine the unit owner two hundred dollars.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Okay, so that would land on Mr. Okafor. Forget it, then.

questions.prompt: What does Chloe learn about getting a replacement fob?

options.text: Mr. Okafor must come in person to sign a form.
options.whyVi: Chủ nhà có thể ký điện tử ('sign it electronically').

options.text: The owner of the unit has to approve the request.
options.whyVi: Đúng: vì họ là người thuê, chủ căn hộ phải điền giấy ủy quyền.

options.text: Tenants can collect fobs on any weekday.
options.whyVi: Chỉ nhận vào thứ Ba và thứ Năm, từ 10 giờ đến 2 giờ.

options.text: The old fob will work until the new one is picked up.
options.whyVi: Fob cũ bị vô hiệu hóa ngay lập tức ('right away').

questions.evidence: Because we're renters, the owner has to fill out an authorization form.
questions.explanationVi: 'The owner has to fill out an authorization form' = chủ nhà phải cho phép/phê duyệt. Đáp án B là cách nói lại.

questions.prompt: How much does an official replacement fob cost?

options.text: Thirty-five dollars.
options.whyVi: Đây là giá làm bản sao ở ki-ốt mà anh họ Farid đã trả.

options.text: Two hundred dollars.
options.whyVi: Đây là tiền phạt nếu dùng fob sao chép.

options.text: One hundred and twenty-five dollars.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'the replacement is a hundred and twenty-five dollars'.

options.text: One hundred and twenty dollars.
options.whyVi: Gần giống nhưng sai; con số đúng là 125, không phải 120.

questions.evidence: But the replacement is a hundred and twenty-five dollars.
questions.explanationVi: Bài có nhiều con số: 125 đô (fob chính thức), 35 đô (bản sao), 200 đô (tiền phạt). Phải ghi chú con số đi với từ 'replacement'.

questions.prompt: Why do they decide against getting a copy made at a kiosk?

options.text: It would cost more than an official fob.
options.whyVi: Bản sao rẻ hơn nhiều (35 đô so với 125 đô).

options.text: Their landlord could be penalized if it were discovered.
options.whyVi: Đúng: nếu phát hiện, chủ căn hộ có thể bị phạt 200 đô.

options.text: Farid's cousin's copy stopped working.
options.whyVi: Anh họ Farid có làm bản sao, nhưng bài không nói nó hỏng.

options.text: The kiosk in Metrotown has closed.
options.whyVi: Bài không nói ki-ốt đã đóng cửa.

questions.evidence: If they find one in the system, they can fine the unit owner two hundred dollars.
questions.explanationVi: 'Fine the unit owner' = chủ căn hộ (landlord) bị phạt; Farid kết luận 'that would land on Mr. Okafor'. 'Fine' được diễn đạt lại thành 'penalized'.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: So, who's paying for it? Not to be difficult, but it was your fob.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: Yeah, no, I know. I'll pay for the fob, obviously. But here's the thing. They also charge a forty-dollar admin fee to the unit's strata account, and that goes on Mr. Okafor's bill.

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: He might try to take it out of our damage deposit.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Can't we just pay him the forty directly? Before he even sees it?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: That's what I was thinking. I'll e-transfer him the forty with a note when I send him the form. It's more honest that way, and he won't be surprised.

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Good call. He's been really decent with us, and I don't want to mess that up. So, pickup's Thursday?

segments.speaker: Chloe
segments.text: Yeah, I'm off at one on Thursday, so I'll go straight to their office on Hastings. Can I keep using yours until then?

segments.speaker: Farid
segments.text: Sure. Just leave it on the hook by the door when you get home.

questions.prompt: How will the forty-dollar admin fee be handled?

options.text: It will be taken out of their damage deposit.
options.whyVi: Đây là điều Chloe lo có thể xảy ra, và họ chọn cách khác để tránh nó.

options.text: Farid and Chloe will split it equally.
options.whyVi: Không ai nói chia đôi khoản phí này.

options.text: Mr. Okafor will pay it himself.
options.whyVi: Phí ghi vào hóa đơn của ông Okafor, nhưng Chloe sẽ chuyển tiền trả lại cho ông.

options.text: Chloe will send the money to the landlord herself.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'I'll e-transfer him the forty with a note'.

questions.evidence: I'll e-transfer him the forty with a note when I send him the form.
questions.explanationVi: Khoản 40 đô bị tính vào tài khoản của chủ nhà, nhưng Chloe quyết định chủ động chuyển khoản trả ông ấy. Chú ý: 'damage deposit' chỉ là điều cô sợ sẽ xảy ra.

questions.prompt: What is Farid's attitude toward their landlord?

options.text: He suspects the landlord will overcharge them.
options.whyVi: Farid khen chủ nhà 'really decent', không nghi ngờ.

options.text: He appreciates the landlord and wants to stay on good terms.
options.whyVi: Đúng: 'He's been really decent with us, and I don't want to mess that up'.

options.text: He thinks the landlord should pay for the new fob.
options.whyVi: Farid không nói chủ nhà nên trả tiền fob; anh còn nhắc fob là của Chloe.

options.text: He is annoyed that the landlord is away in Calgary.
options.whyVi: Calgary có được nhắc nhưng Farid không tỏ ra bực bội.

questions.evidence: He's been really decent with us, and I don't want to mess that up.
questions.explanationVi: 'Decent' = tử tế; 'I don't want to mess that up' = không muốn làm hỏng mối quan hệ tốt. Đáp án B là cách nói lại.

vocabulary.vi: thẻ/chìa từ mở cửa tòa nhà
vocabulary.definition: a small electronic device used to open building doors
vocabulary.example: I think my building fob fell out at the bus stop.

vocabulary.vi: bãi đỗ xe nhiều tầng (từ Canada)
vocabulary.definition: a multi-level parking garage, a common Canadian word
vocabulary.example: Anyone with the fob can get into the parkade.

vocabulary.definition: to make a device or account stop working
vocabulary.example: They'll deactivate the old fob right away.

vocabulary.definition: a document that gives official permission
vocabulary.example: The owner has to sign an authorization form.

vocabulary.vi: quy định nội bộ (của strata/thành phố)
vocabulary.definition: a rule made by a strata corporation or local government
vocabulary.example: The strata bylaws don't allow copied fobs.

vocabulary.vi: tiền đặt cọc (bảo đảm hư hỏng)
vocabulary.definition: money a tenant pays at the start of a tenancy; in BC the landlord can keep part of it only with the tenant's written agreement or a Residential Tenancy Branch order
vocabulary.example: He might take the fee out of our damage deposit.

vocabulary.definition: to send money electronically from one bank account to another
vocabulary.example: I'll e-transfer him the forty dollars tonight.

review.notes: Blind-solved all 8 Qs; key matched. Changed: softened Chloe's line about the landlord simply deducting from the damage deposit and corrected the vocab definition (in BC a landlord needs written consent or an RTB order); Q2 option B whyVi said 'last year' while transcript says 'last spring' - fixed.
